hops.name: spine
hops.notes: Warped fbm field, palette, feedback-ready composite

hops.name: domain-warp
hops.target: Recursive domain warp: fbm(p + fbm(p + fbm(p))). Stay within 6 octaves/call.
hops.notes: Three chained fbm levels (q->r->s) + organicDrift pre-warp; mouse bias on zoom_config.w. Gate: naga OK, bindgroup compatible.

hops.name: symmetry-fold
hops.target: Polar kaleidoscope fold on UV before field sample. N-fold via zoom_params or fixed 6-fold.
hops.notes: 6-fold polar kaleidoscope; slow time spin; mouse-centers fold origin when held. No zoom_params stolen.

hops.name: palette
hops.target: IQ cosine palette or enhanced psychedelicPalette. Only chunk that assigns RGB.
hops.notes: Hybrid: psychedelicPalette base + IQ cosine interference bands (mix 0.45, slower phase t*0.5+field*0.7). sampleField gains ridged fbm layer (mix 0.3). Saturation/hueShift semantics kept; output clamped to 1.2. Gate: naga OK, bindgroup compatible. Visual check pending (no GPU on this VM).

hops.name: temporal-feedback
hops.target: Echo trails via dataTextureC. Decay + optional UV warp on history sample.
hops.notes: organicDrift UV warp + dual bilinear dataTextureC taps; decay 0.86–0.97; luminance-weighted echo mix.

hops.name: motion-modulation
hops.target: LFOs pushing warp/palette past legibility. Audio via plasmaBuffer.
hops.notes: Multi-LFO stack (slow/mid/fast/spark); bass warp surge; mids time+sat; treble hue+sparkle. MotionState adds saturationBoost + hueDrift wired to applyPalette.

hops.name: polish
hops.target: neonGlow, subtle chromatic split on generative color (no readTexture). Final QA.
